name: OT: VPN access, EWS compromise and PLC change from same workstation
description: Correlates FortiGate remote-access traffic from the VPN pool to an engineering workstation, a Microsoft Defender alert on that workstation, and a Claroty CTD PLC modification alert originating from it, in that order. Indicates possible use of stolen remote-access credentials to tamper with OT process control.
query:
FROM logs-fortinet_fortigate.log-*, logs-microsoft_defender_endpoint.log-*, logs-claroty_ctd.event-*
| WHERE
    (event.dataset == "fortinet_fortigate.log"
      AND event.outcome == "success"
      AND CIDR_MATCH(source.ip, "10.99.0.0/24")
      AND destination.port IN (3389, 445, 5985))
    OR (event.dataset == "microsoft_defender_endpoint.log"
      AND event.kind == "alert")
    OR (event.dataset == "claroty_ctd.event"
      AND event.kind == "alert"
      AND claroty_ctd.event.name IN ("PLC Program Download Detected", "PLC Configuration Change", "Unauthorized Write"))
| EVAL ews_ip = CASE(
    event.dataset == "fortinet_fortigate.log", destination.ip,
    event.dataset == "claroty_ctd.event", source.ip,
    related.ip)
| MV_EXPAND ews_ip
| WHERE ews_ip IS NOT NULL
| STATS
    vpn_hops       = COUNT(*)                     WHERE event.dataset == "fortinet_fortigate.log",
    defender_hits  = COUNT(*)                     WHERE event.dataset == "microsoft_defender_endpoint.log",
    claroty_hits   = COUNT(*)                     WHERE event.dataset == "claroty_ctd.event",
    first_vpn      = MIN(@timestamp)              WHERE event.dataset == "fortinet_fortigate.log",
    first_defender = MIN(@timestamp)              WHERE event.dataset == "microsoft_defender_endpoint.log",
    first_claroty  = MIN(@timestamp)              WHERE event.dataset == "claroty_ctd.event",
    vpn_users      = VALUES(source.user.name)     WHERE event.dataset == "fortinet_fortigate.log",
    claroty_alerts = VALUES(claroty_ctd.event.name) WHERE event.dataset == "claroty_ctd.event"
  BY ews_ip
| WHERE vpn_hops > 0 AND defender_hits > 0 AND claroty_hits > 0
    AND first_vpn <= first_defender AND first_defender <= first_claroty
| EVAL minutes_vpn_to_plc = DATE_DIFF("minutes", first_vpn, first_claroty)
| KEEP ews_ip, first_vpn, first_defender, first_claroty, minutes_vpn_to_plc, vpn_users, vpn_hops, defender_hits, claroty_hits, claroty_alerts
| SORT first_claroty DESC
tags: Data Source: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
false_positives: Authorised remote maintenance by vendors or engineers during approved change windows
Legitimate PLC programming following a Defender false positive on the EWS
note:
Triage: identify the EWS (ews_ip), the VPN user(s), the Defender alert and the Claroty alert. Check change tickets for the EWS. If unapproved, isolate the EWS and the VPN account, and inform the OT/plant operations owner before any action that could affect the process.

MITRE ATT&CK for ICS: T0836 Modify Parameter and T0843 Program Download are carried as tags and references, because the Kibana rule threat mapping covers Enterprise ATT&CK only. T0810 Data Historian Compromise is an adjacent technique.
